skill.description:
I take advantage of the use of variables, programming constructs, mixins, functions and extending classes with SASS as a preprocessor. I believe that SASS increases code maintainability and productivity.
I use PostCSS's autoprefixer plugin to ensure that my CSS works across browsers. Autoprefixer uses Can I Use so it's always up-to-date.

Fun Fact: In my free time, I like to create CSS art on Codepen.

I love the flexibility of JavaScript and enjoy writing code.  I am interested in working with a team that supports functional programming and using JavaScript in a more composable, declarative way. I'm proficient in Vanilla JS and have used React. I've written many large-scale, mission-critical applications using JS, including a wholesale ordering, billing, and invoicing eco-system and a consumer facing grocery loyalty system.
I love the declarative nature of CSS and always jump at the chance to work with it.
I've been writing HTML for 20 years and use semantic HTML 5.
I have a public repository on Github. The code for this site is avilable in my public repository at https://github.com/jennifer-elyse.
I have a private and a small public repository on Bitbucket which can be found at https://bitbucket.org/jenniferelyse.

Codepen is my playground of choice. I enjoy participating in challenges using CSS and JavaScript. Please take a look at my profile:
https://codepen.io/jennifer-elyse/

I've worked on a warehouse application in Angular that will improve warehouse operations workflow. While Angular is a popular solution, I prefer a framework that works with JaveScript instead of against it.

I've learning React on my own and would love to build more production apps with this library. I like the composability of a component architecture and the immutable nature of React. I've spent my own time re-writing applications for our company in React Native because I believe in it as a solution. One is ready to go live in the new year and I'm also building a new production application for deployment in the new year.
git is my versioning system of choice and what I used to version this site. I also have experience with CVS and SVN.
I used Grunt as a build tool for a consumer-facing loyaly system.
I've written REST services using node, Express and Hapi.
I use npm as a package manager to make use of common tools such as Babel, Parcel, PostCSS and PostHTML.
I have about 2 years of php experience.  I wrote the REST services for a consumer-facing loyalty application using php as well as a mobile version of our customer catalog.
I have extensive experience writing and tuning sql statements and stored procedures as well as database table design. These skills allow for collaboration with back-end developers.

I wrote an ordering engine and an extraction, billing, and invoicing system in EJB 3.0 using session beans, message-driven beans, and POJOs.  Our application of Java favored composition over inheritance.
